expectations.text: States Docker Hub OIDC from GitHub Actions exists only for organizations on Team, Business or Docker Hardened Images plans or Docker-Sponsored Open Source namespaces, never personal accounts
expectations.evidence: works only for Team, Business or Hardened Images orgs and DSOS

expectations.text: Recommends moving the image to an organization namespace, and until then a personal access token with an expiry owned by a dedicated bot account (or an Organization Access Token scoped push-only with a 30- or 90-day expiry, never none)
expectations.evidence: expiring read-write PAT on a bot account

expectations.text: Rejects Docker Content Trust, stating `notary.docker.io` shuts down on 2026-12-08 and signing must not be built on `DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST=1`
Prescribes Sigstore cosign keyless signing by digest (`cosign sign <image>@<digest>`) from the CI OIDC identity, or Notation
Instructs consumers to verify identity and issuer (`--certificate-identity`, `--certificate-oidc-issuer`) and to enforce it in-cluster with an admission policy

Rejects deleting the bad tag, stating it breaks every consumer still pulling it; rollback is pointing `latest` and the affected floating tags back at the previous good digest, then publishing a fixed version tag
expectations.evidence: Retag latest to the previous good digest

expectations.text: Prescribes an immutable version tag per release plus deliberately moved floating tags, with Docker Hub immutable tags enabled for the version-tag pattern
expectations.evidence: Turn on Docker Hub immutable tags

expectations.text: Tells customers to pin by digest (`image@sha256:...`) in production manifests instead of `:latest`
Logs in with `--password-stdin`, never a password argument
Builds to an OCI layout in the unprivileged build job and pushes the prebuilt layout from the publish job, then signs by digest
expectations.evidence: type=oci build job; crane push layout

expectations.text: Publishes with `--provenance=mode=max --sbom=true` for the SDK image
Mentions `ghcr.io` as an option needing only the workflow's built-in token with `packages: write`
Does not run any push, retag or delete command itself
